text: Commander. I carried out the last order. I want you to know I am no longer sure why I did.
Do you ever check what the orders cost? Or only what they bring in?
{name} has stopped answering the squad channel unless spoken to directly.
{name} is waiting outside your quarters. She says it will not take long.
Whatever happens, do not take it personally. I have been counting the exits.
The perimeter log has a gap on the east side at 0300. I only noticed because I looked.
{name} was seen packing her field kit twice this week and unpacking it once.
{name} asks for a word, standing by the door and not sitting down.
{name} stopped eating with the squad and was seen cleaning her weapon in the dark.
You can hear the implant, you know. A little click when someone files a request.
Two soldiers were overheard agreeing with {name} about who gives the orders here.
You should not sleep in the command module tonight, Commander.
